about_text:
I'm Heaven, an artist based in Marietta, Georgia. I've been tattooing since January 2023, but I've been making art for as long as I can remember. My tattoo work focuses on bold color, fine lines, and black & grey, but my creativity doesn't stop at tattooing. I also love painting, drawing, and experimenting with mixed media.

My style ranges from colorful, playful designs to darker, more intricate pieces. I draw inspiration from nature, mythology, strange creatures, and whatever fixation has taken over my brain that week. I've always been drawn to the whimsical, the unconventional, and the contrast between beautiful and bizarre.

My approach to tattooing is collaborative and low pressure. Whether you have a fully developed idea or just a vague concept, I love helping turn it into something personal. I want you to feel comfortable throughout the process, whether that means asking a hundred questions, chatting the entire appointment, or sitting quietly with your headphones on. There's no correct way to get tattooed.

When I'm not tattooing, I'm usually making something anyway- painting, illustrating, designing flash, or picking up another craft I probably don't need.

I created this website as an alternative to social media and a way to showcase all my work in one organized space, without relying on an algorithm. 
Whether you're here for tattoos or just interested in art as a whole, consider this a little peek at what I do.

Thanks for being here and taking the time to explore my work!
